notes.title: May 13th Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Stability improvements; at worst, this should only reset you to the beginning of the current chapter.
[*] Dataweaver Gift should, at long last, be available to Glass Walkers
[*] Holds-the-Dawn’s Gift should, at long last, be available to Shadow Lords
[*] Character events are now showing up in the journal after their various grisly fates, not at the start of the relevant chapter
[*] Fixed countless minor bugs and logical hiccoughs
[/list]

notes.title: Unleash the Beast Within with a New Werewolf: The Apocalypse Bundle!
notes.content:
Hey Werewolf fans,

Great news for the World of Darkness community! We've just launched an exciting bundle that pairs two great games: our friends' latest release, Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names, with our Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest.

[b]Bundle Details:[/b]
Enjoy both of these gripping narratives set in the rich, dark story of the Garou for a bundled discount of 10%, now increased to 40% for a limited time until May 10th. Plus, if you already own one of the games, you'll receive an extra discount to complete your set!

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1342620/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Heart_of_the_Forest/?snr=1_5_9_]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest[/url] takes you on a journey into Europe’s last wilderness where you play as Maia, who arrives at the ancient Białowieża Forest looking to explore her family history.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402280/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__The_Book_of_Hungry_Names/?snr=1_5_9_]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — The Book of Hungry Names[/url] introduces you to a new adventure with hundreds of choices, where you'll face the Wyrm Spirit and uncover lies you might want to believe.
[/list]


Dive deeper into the mysteries of the World of Darkness with this special offer!

notes.title: May 6th Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added an extra opportunity to hang out with packmates or ask them on dates in the hub chapter
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clarified what the first DLC offers and how it works
[*] Dataweaver and Gremlin Gifts should now be showing up correctly
[*] Improved continuity for Drax and his various grisly fates
[*] Added a newspaper report for if you frenzy at Hog Throne in “Music from Another Time” so it doesn’t sound like everyone had fun
[*] Standardized the personality stat names
[*] Achievements for fully restoring the barrows, woods, and urban blight should be appearing correctly now
[*] Countless minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: April 29th Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] DLC Tribes now selectable
[*] Fixed bug in “Threnody for Gigabytes” that has the drone join you even when you refuse to work with him
[*] Also fixed some “wrong goal” bugs when 
[*] You can now Fix the Heat
[*] Instance of Podge appearing before recruiting him fixed
[*] Gremlin now available to Glass Walkers, as intended
[*] Mother Bear requirements now appearing properly
[*] Fixed “drop out of the choice” bugs when you regenerate in “The Year Made of Glass” and the last chapter
[*] Some other minor but quite embarrassing continuity and stability fixes
[/list]

notes.title: April 26th Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The 486 now displays possible commands, so you can't get stuck because you don't have a command list.
[*] Continuity problems with the "cops hassle you in an alley" scene should be cleared up
[*] Clarified the requirements for joining a tribe.
[*] Can no longer proceed to Melodie without helping Nin regain the Wolf.
[/list]
